products.title: CIRUI Custom Forged Wheel Set – Corvette C8
products.description_html:
Custom-made set of 4 CIRUI forged monoblock wheels for a Chevrolet Corvette C8 Z51/Z06 with OEM iron brakes.

fully colored sales and configuration sheet rendering your exact custom split-Y spokes from Cirui Forged.This breakdown presents your custom 19” Front and 20” Rear staggered diameters across all three finishes alongside the final production metadata.Here’s your generated image.

📋 CIRUI FORGED MASTER SPECIFICATION PACKAGEVehicle Target: 2022 Chevrolet Corvette C8 Stingray HTC (Z51 Package Footprint)Production Class: Bespoke CNC 6061-T6 Monoblock Aerospace Forgings

🎨 Finish & Visual Analysis MatrixColumn 1: Liquid Black Chrome (Translucent PVD)Surface Profile: High-gloss mirror base underneath a dark-tinted clear PVD protective coat.

19” Front Behavior (19x9J ET45): The smoky dark surface catches high overhead light, making the sharp corner breaks on your split Y-spokes appear crisp.

20” Rear Behavior (20x11.5J ET52): Darkens significantly deep inside the drop-center window wells, creating an aggressive, liquid-metal look that contrasts sharply against the bright red Brembo M4.38 calipers.

Column 2: Brushed Dark Tint (Technical Graphite)Surface Profile: Unidirectional fine-line hand brushing underneath a semi-gloss/satin smoky clear powder coat layer.

19” Front Behavior (19x9J ET45): Accentuates the physical machining cuts of the spoke flanks. The satin texture breaks up road glare seamlessly.

20” Rear Behavior (20x11.5J ET52): Subdues the deep barrel geometry slightly into a focused, motorsport-oriented track aesthetic while keeping the brushed metal lines perfectly visible.

Column 3: True Chrome (Hyper-Reflective Mirror)Surface Profile: Mirror-polished aluminum substrate treated with a complete high-luster decorative multi-layer chrome deposition.

19” Front Behavior (19x9J ET45): Maximizes visual presence, making the 19" wheel geometry appear larger on the front wheel arches.

20” Rear Behavior (20x11.5J ET52): Turns the wide 11.5J inner barrel wall into an ongoing mirror. The deep barrel reflects the geometry of the radial heat-sink fins and throws bright reflections of your braking hardware out through the spoke pockets.

🛠️ Final Manufacturing Technical ChecklistWhen Cirui Forged returns the final technical blue line files for structural validation, confirm that the following values are locked into their CNC milling logic:Hub Integration: Hub-centric direct profile at 66.9 mm Center Bore matching your factory C8 hubs exactly to eliminate highway vibration.Bead Shoulder: Micro-grooved knurled bead seats machined onto both inside and outside tire mounting zones to stop run-flat tire slippage under track braking loads.Lip Geometry Alignment: CNC engraving program mapped radially at 180° true separation. "CORVETTE" sits flush inside the top window gap (0°), and "FORGED" splits down the middle of the opposing bottom-center spoke profile (180°). Both utilize the official wide, geometric block branding font.Internal Barrel Gaps: Zone 1 (Smooth Section) spans 100mm from the front face on the 19” front wheels to ensure a minimum 5.0mm safe air gap over the wide Z51 Brembos. Zone 2 (Radial Ridges) contains shallow U-grooves carved 2.5mm deep on the fronts and a deeper 4.0mm deep layout on the concave rears to speed up heat-sink performance.

🎨 Finish & Visual Analysis MatrixColumn 1: Liquid Black Chrome (Translucent PVD)Surface Profile: High-gloss mirror base underneath a dark-tinted clear PVD protective coat.

19” Front Behavior (19x9J ET45): The smoky dark surface catches high overhead light, making the sharp corner breaks on your split Y-spokes appear crisp.

20” Rear Behavior (20x11.5J ET52): Darkens significantly deep inside the drop-center window wells, creating an aggressive, liquid-metal look that contrasts sharply against the bright red Brembo M4.38 calipers.

Column 2: Brushed Dark Tint (Technical Graphite)Surface Profile: Unidirectional fine-line hand brushing underneath a semi-gloss/satin smoky clear powder coat layer.

19” Front Behavior (19x9J ET45): Accentuates the physical machining cuts of the spoke flanks. The satin texture breaks up road glare seamlessly.

20” Rear Behavior (20x11.5J ET52): Subdues the deep barrel geometry slightly into a focused, motorsport-oriented track aesthetic while keeping the brushed metal lines perfectly visible.

Column 3: True Chrome (Hyper-Reflective Mirror)Surface Profile: Mirror-polished aluminum substrate treated with a complete high-luster decorative multi-layer chrome deposition.

19” Front Behavior (19x9J ET45): Maximizes visual presence, making the 19" wheel geometry appear larger on the front wheel arches.

20” Rear Behavior (20x11.5J ET52): Turns the wide 11.5J inner barrel wall into an ongoing mirror. The deep barrel reflects the geometry of the radial heat-sink fins and throws bright reflections of your braking hardware out through the spoke pockets.

🛠️ Final Manufacturing Technical ChecklistWhen Cirui Forged returns the final technical blue line files for structural validation, confirm that the following values are locked into their CNC milling logic:Hub Integration: Hub-centric direct profile at 66.9 mm Center Bore matching your factory C8 hubs exactly to eliminate highway vibration.Bead Shoulder: Micro-grooved knurled bead seats machined onto both inside and outside tire mounting zones to stop run-flat tire slippage under track braking loads.Lip Geometry Alignment: CNC engraving program mapped radially at 180° true separation. "CORVETTE" sits flush inside the top window gap (0°), and "FORGED" splits down the middle of the opposing bottom-center spoke profile (180°). Both utilize the official wide, geometric block branding font.Internal Barrel Gaps: Zone 1 (Smooth Section) spans 100mm from the front face on the 19” front wheels to ensure a minimum 5.0mm safe air gap over the wide Z51 Brembos. Zone 2 (Radial Ridges) contains shallow U-grooves carved 2.5mm deep on the fronts and a deeper 4.0mm deep layout on the concave rears to speed up heat-sink performance.

From your idea to production

  1. Agree on the order brief. We discuss your vehicle, design direction, quantity, price, delivery scope and estimated schedule.
  2. Check the final quotation and pay. This custom-order route uses full payment, rather than a deposit. Review the revised order amount before checkout.
  3. Review the engineering design. After the order is placed, our engineering team prepares the vehicle-specific design and confirms the dimensions, finish and details with you. We work with you on revisions to the agreed design until you are happy to approve it, within the confirmed engineering and order scope.
  4. Approve before production. Manufacturing begins after the final design and specification are approved. Please raise any changes before approval; later changes may affect feasibility, price or timing and must be confirmed with us.
  5. Production, inspection and delivery. Your approved wheels are manufactured, finished, inspected and packed for the agreed shipping route.

The gallery contains illustrative 3D design previews. Screen colors, lighting and perspective can differ from physical finishes. The approved production drawing and agreed finish specification define your order.

Payment, delivery and what is included

Full payment is required for this custom order. Use the payment methods offered at your confirmed checkout; PayPal or credit-card availability depends on the checkout options shown for your order. Keep your Shopify order confirmation and payment receipt.

Your written quotation confirms the number of wheels, finish, center caps and any additional hardware or accessories. Tires, TPMS sensors, installation, carbon-fiber details and other extras are not automatically included; any included items must be listed in your quotation.

Shipping, taxes and accessories are included only when stated in your agreed quotation. Duty-paid (DDP) delivery can be quoted for eligible destinations in Europe and North America. Confirm the destination, duties and final delivery scope before payment rather than assuming worldwide free shipping.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed with your final specification and destination. Ask us to record the estimated production-plus-transit schedule in your quotation. Design revisions, special finishes, engineering requirements and customs or transport delays can affect timing. See our Delivery & DDP information.

Five-year quality warranty and lifetime after-sales support

CIRUI provides a five-year product-quality warranty for confirmed material or manufacturing defects. Under our published warranty commitment, a covered defect within this period is addressed through compensation equal to 100% of the affected wheel’s purchase price or a corresponding replacement wheel at no charge. This concerns the affected wheel, not an automatic refund of the entire set.

Damage caused by impacts, collisions, curb contact, improper use or vehicle modifications falls outside the quality-defect compensation scope. Lifetime after-sales support means continuing assistance with technical assessment, inspection, replacement-wheel inquiries and service matters; it does not mean lifetime free replacement or reimbursement for every type of damage.

For an after-sales request, contact CIRUI with your order number, a description of the issue and clear photographs. We will review the order and the reported problem with you. For cancellation or change requests, contact us promptly so we can check the actual production stage and discuss the applicable next steps before you take further action.

About CIRUI Forged

CIRUI Forged, known as 策锐锻造 in China, brings a factory and engineering approach to custom wheels. Our wheel-industry background dates to 2008, with the CIRUI/策锐 brand established in 2016. Wheel manufacturing is based in Shandong, China, and international sales are handled by Sichuan Fanghe Overseas Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.

Our work covers vehicle-specific design review, forging, CNC machining, finishing, inspection and customer support. Learn more about our factory and engineering and custom wheel program.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S101 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S101 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S101
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order

products.title: CIRUI CR-S111 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S111 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S111
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

CIRUI CR-C2203 · 2-Piece · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-C2203
Construction Two-piece forged center and barrel configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Explore Brushed Silver · Build Gallery · Factory & Engineering

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

AI design visualizations. Final dimensions, PCD, offset, center bore, load requirements and brake clearance are confirmed for the exact vehicle before production.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S102 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S102 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S102
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S103 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S103 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S103
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S109 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S109 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S109
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Explore Brushed Silver · Build Gallery · Factory & Engineering

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

AI design visualizations. Final dimensions, PCD, offset, center bore, load requirements and brake clearance are confirmed for the exact vehicle before production.

products.title: CIRUI CR-C2204 Brushed Silver 2-Piece Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-C2204 · 2-Piece · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-C2204
Construction Two-piece forged center and barrel configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Explore Brushed Silver · Build Gallery · Factory & Engineering

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S104 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S104 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S104
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S110 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S110 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S110
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Explore Brushed Silver · Build Gallery · Factory & Engineering

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

AI design visualizations. Final dimensions, PCD, offset, center bore, load requirements and brake clearance are confirmed for the exact vehicle before production.

products.title: CIRUI CR-C2205 Brushed Silver 2-Piece Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-C2205 · 2-Piece · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-C2205
Construction Two-piece forged center and barrel configuration

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. products.title: CIRUI CR-C2206 Brushed Silver 2-Piece Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-C2206 · 2-Piece · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-C2206
Construction Two-piece forged center and barrel configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S117 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S117 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S117
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Explore Brushed Silver · Build Gallery · Factory & Engineering

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

AI design visualizations. Final dimensions, PCD, offset, center bore, load requirements and brake clearance are confirmed for the exact vehicle before production.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S105 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S105 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S105
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Explore Brushed Silver · Build Gallery · Factory & Engineering

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S106 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S106 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S106
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Explore Brushed Silver · Build Gallery · Factory & Engineering

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S112 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S112 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S112
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Explore Brushed Silver · Build Gallery · Factory & Engineering

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

AI design visualizations. Final dimensions, PCD, offset, center bore, load requirements and brake clearance are confirmed for the exact vehicle before production.

products.title: CIRUI CR-C2207 Brushed Silver 2-Piece Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-C2207 · 2-Piece · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-C2207
Construction Two-piece forged center and barrel configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S118 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S118 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S118
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S107 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S107 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S107
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S113 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S113 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S113
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S114 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S114 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S114
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

products.title: CIRUI CR-C2208 Brushed Silver 2-Piece Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-C2208 · 2-Piece · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-C2208
Construction Two-piece forged center and barrel configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

products.title: CIRUI CR-AS01 Brushed Silver AeroSport Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-AS01 · AeroSport Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-AS01
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.

Your vehicle. Your approved fitment.

Confirm the model, year, trim, brake package, suspension, tire plan and intended use. CIRUI reviews the wheel dimensions, load requirements and brake clearance, then provides the agreed 3D drawing and finish details for approval before final production. Any project-specific testing or reporting is defined in the agreed validation plan.

Wheel concavity, hub details and hardware follow the final fitment and construction. The design images illustrate appearance; they do not establish tested fitment or a certification for a particular vehicle. Gallery media are AI-edited design visualizations.

Colors and delivery

Brushed silver is the main collection direction. Satin black, satin bronze and standard custom painted colors are available through the listed finish plans. Gloss or satin clearcoat for a custom painted color is confirmed before production. Special chrome, additional multi-stage effects or other finishes outside those plans require a separately agreed specification before purchase.

Production and delivery timing are confirmed for the approved design, finish and destination. Follow the order confirmation for the final specification and delivery scope.

Explore Brushed Silver · Build Gallery · Factory & Engineering

Vehicle & Finish Design Studies

Explore the same wheel design on different vehicle shapes and compare finish directions. Colors can be customized; your selected option, agreed finish sample and approved production drawing define your order.

AI design visualizations. Final dimensions, PCD, offset, center bore, load requirements and brake clearance are confirmed for the exact vehicle before production.

products.title: CIRUI CR-S108 Brushed Silver Monoblock Forged Wheels | Set of 4
products.description_html:
CIRUI CR-S108 · Monoblock · Made to order · Set of 4 wheels.

Start with the brushed silver design direction, or choose a black, bronze or custom painted finish. The gallery shows the same wheel style in multiple views and finish examples. Quantity 1 is a complete four-wheel set; tires are not included.

Configure your wheel set

  • Wheel diameter: 17–24 inches. If front and rear diameters differ, select the larger diameter; the approved drawing records both axle sizes.
  • Width plan: 8J–13J in half-inch steps. A numerical Square option applies that width to all four wheels. Select Staggered - Approved Drawing for different front and rear widths.
  • Finish: choose one of the priced finish plans above. Custom Color includes a single standard painted color, confirmed with CIRUI before production.

For a staggered set, confirm the exact front and rear diameters and widths with CIRUI before production. All dimensions must remain within the selected maximum diameter and the agreed engineering specification.

Design and specification

Design code CR-S108
Construction One-piece monoblock forged configuration
Material specification 6061-T6 forged aluminum, defined in the approved production drawing
Diameter range 17–24 in
Width range 8–13J, square or agreed staggered layout
PCD, center bore and offset Configured for the exact vehicle and approved drawing
Center caps CIRUI circular CR branding; cap and mounting details confirmed with the order
Quantity 4 wheels per set

Set pricing by diameter and finish

USD per complete four-wheel set. Standard shipping included. Width choices within the listed range do not add a separate width charge. The selected maximum diameter and finish plan determine the price.
